purpose: Design-only D1 feature export contract for future Phase 2 PIT-safe feature matrix generation.

forecast_anchor_rule.d1_trade_date_rule: D1 trade_date T is usable only from T+1 06:00 Europe/Moscow or later.

eligibility_rules: availability_ts_utc must be parseable as UTC.
D1 trade_date T must not be exported before T+1 06:00 Europe/Moscow.
Rolling windows must include only rows eligible by the same forecast_anchor_ts.
Unknown release timestamp must shift by at least one trading day or exclude the row.

feature_groups_allowed_design_only.market_d1_ohlc_context: Lagged D1 market context derived from approved D1 OHLC only after D1 T+1 rule.
feature_groups_allowed_design_only.ema_3_19_context: EMA 3/19 context and diagnostics only; not a label source.
feature_groups_allowed_design_only.classical_d1_indicators: Lagged returns, range, volatility, and momentum context only.
feature_groups_allowed_design_only.participant_positioning_context: FUTOI participant positioning semantics only after PIT availability is resolved.

allowed: EMA derived only from D1 OHLC values already eligible by forecast_anchor_ts
forbidden: EMA calculated from same-day unavailable close values

denylist_rule: Runtime/model feature export must reject every field matching the denylist, including wildcard namespaces.
explicit_non_authorizations: No export is generated by this contract.
